# #3793: Patch: the AI's count of next turn's attacks leaves out a unit its Brittle destroys before it can swing
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some units crumble on a timer. At the start of their owner's turn the count drops, and at zero the unit is destroyed, before it can attack. When the computer opponent works out how hard your board could hit it next turn, it still counts a unit that will crumble first.

For example, a grown Corpse Eater has Rush and Brittle 1, so it is destroyed at the start of its owner's next turn and can never hit a hero. At 8 attack it still makes the AI believe it faces lethal. The AI then pulls its own units back into Defense and passes up attacks it should make. Once this is built, the AI counts only the units that will still be standing when their turn's attacks come. The AI's own crumbling units stop counting as pressure too.

## Why

- `can_swing` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:125-132`) checks Can't attack, E35 and Frozen-through-next-turn, but not Brittle. `face_threat_with` (`evaluate.rs:927-941`) and `could_attack_next_turn` (`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs:996-1001`) take it as "may swing next turn".
- `wall_switches` (`candidates.rs:962`) and `stands_down` (`candidates.rs:938`) build their Defense switches from that count. `lethal_threat` is 150 (`crates/ai/src/config.rs:660`).
- Nothing in `crates/ai/src` reads when a Brittle tick is due. `brittle_share` (`evaluate.rs:118`) only discounts the unit's worth.
- The rule: §6.1's Brittle row (`spec/06-keywords.md:56`). The tick runs at the start of the controller's turn, after the mana refresh, from turn t + 2 (`BRITTLE_FIRST_TICK_TURNS`, `crates/engine/src/config.rs:576`), and at 0 the card is destroyed. Indestructible ignores it (R46).
- Cards: Core #89 Corpse Eater (Rush, Brittle 1, grows in hand; `spec/08-catalog.md:140`), S #101 Overdrive Module (Brittle 2, then 1; `:686`), and any unit given Brittle by an effect.
- The search replays the opponent's reply through the real `reduce`, which sees the crumble. But the beam's static ranking and the wall and stand-down candidates are built from this count first, so phantom-lethal lines take beam slots (width 4) that real lines needed.

## Proposal

- Add a helper: the unit is destroyed by its own Brittle tick before its controller's next attacks. That means its active count is 1, its tick is due by that turn's start, and the destroy would take it (not Indestructible, R46). It reads the engine's Brittle state (`active_brittle_count` and the count's start). If the engine lacks a read for "tick due by turn N", that read goes into `crates/engine/src/query.rs` with its test.
- `face_threat_with` and `could_attack_next_turn` skip such a unit. `unit_worth` is left alone, since its Brittle share already discounts the unit.
- Gate it behind an `EvalWeights` flag, on in `AI_EVAL` and off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, as `gauntlet_bars_face_attacks` was (`config.rs:362,540,780`), so the greedy baseline stays frozen.
- A ruling in this issue's block on the §9.9 reading, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`.

## Where it lands

`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/`, possibly `crates/engine/src/query.rs`. SPEC §6.1 (Brittle), §9.9.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An enemy Brittle-1 unit whose tick falls before its next turn's attacks adds 0 to `face_threat`, and `wall_switches` and `stands_down` offer no switch on its account.
- [ ] The same unit with its first tick not yet due still counts, and so does an Indestructible one.
- [ ] The AI's own such unit adds no lethal pressure.
- [ ] `GREEDY_EVAL`'s decisions are unchanged (flag off).
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo jackioh gate` and `cargo jackioh spec check` are green.

## Size and risks

Small to medium: one helper, two call sites, one flag, tests. `difficulty:hard` (the AI). Risk: getting the tick's turn wrong around extra turns. The helper reads the engine's own count and start rather than re-deriving them, and a test covers an extra turn if the engine counts one as a turn start.

## Goal

An enemy or own unit whose Brittle tick destroys it at the start of its controller's next turn, before it can swing, counts as no attack. It adds 0 to `face_threat`, and `could_attack_next_turn` rejects it, so `stands_down` and `wall_switches` offer no switch on its account. A unit whose first tick is not yet due, a unit at Brittle 2 or more, and an Indestructible unit still count. The behavior sits behind a new `EvalWeights` flag, `brittle_crumbles_before_swing`, on in `AI_EVAL` and off in `GREEDY_EVAL`. `unit_worth` is untouched. A ruling, R3793000, records the reading.

| `crates/engine/src/brittle.rs` | change | `brittle_due` calls `crate::query::brittle_due_by(card, state.turn)`. Drop `BRITTLE_FIRST_TICK_TURNS` from the line-11 `config` import, since it would be unused. |

## Steps

1. **`query.rs`.** After `brittle_spent`, add:
   ```rust
   /// R385, R638: whether the card's Brittle count ticks at the start of its controller's turn numbered
   /// `turn`: the first tick is the first start numbered `since + BRITTLE_FIRST_TICK_TURNS` or later, and
   /// every start after it. False for a card with no count. `brittle::brittle_due` asks it of the turn under
   /// way; the AI asks it of its controller's next start (R3793000).
   pub fn brittle_due_by(card: &CardInstance, turn: i32) -> bool {
       card.brittle.is_some_and(|brittle| turn >= brittle.since + BRITTLE_FIRST_TICK_TURNS)
   }
   ```
   It is exported at the crate root through `pub use query::*`.

2. **`brittle.rs`.** Replace the body of `brittle_due` with `crate::query::brittle_due_by(card, state.turn)` and keep its doc comment. Remove the now-unused constant from the import. Behavior is identical.

3. **`config.rs`.** Add the field to `EvalWeights` with this doc: "R3793000, #3793: whether `face_threat` and `could_attack_next_turn` (so `wall_switches` and `stands_down`) leave out a unit its own Brittle tick destroys at the start of its controller's next turn, before it can attack. `unit_worth` is untouched: its Brittle share already discounts the unit. Off, every unit that may swing counts, as before." Set `true` in `AI_EVAL` and `false` in `GREEDY_EVAL`. These two literals are the only places that list every field.

4. **`evaluate.rs`.**
   - Imports: add `BRITTLE_TICK` to the `jackioh_engine::config::{…}` list and `brittle_due_by` to the `jackioh_engine::{…}` list. `active_brittle_count`, `has_keyword` and `KeywordKind` are already imported.
   - Add `const ONE_TURN: i32 = 1;` (a started turn, extra ones included; CLAUDE.md rule 9).
   - Add `fn next_turn_start(state: &GameState, player: PlayerId) -> i32`. It is the number `state.turn` has at the start of `player`'s next turn, at the earliest:
     ```rust
     let owes_extra = state.players[player].extra_turns.unwrap_or(0) > 0;
     let other_first = state.active == player && !owes_extra;
     state.turn + if other_first { 2 * ONE_TURN } else { ONE_TURN }
     ```
     Doc: an owed extra turn starts at once (R846, `take_owed_extra_turn`). The other player's extra turns only push the start later, and a later start is due whenever an earlier one is, so they are left out and can only over-count, as before.

     - `brittle_due_by(unit, next_turn_start(state, unit.controller))`.
     - `!has_keyword(&view.keywords, KeywordKind::Indestructible)` (R46).
   - Add `pub(crate) fn can_swing_next_turn(state, unit, view, w: &EvalWeights) -> bool`:
     `can_swing(state, unit, view) && !(w.brittle_crumbles_before_swing && crumbles_before_swinging(state, unit, view))`. Leave `can_swing` as it is: `unit_worth` still calls it.

Update its doc. `stands_down` and `wall_switches` take no weights and already read `AI_EVAL` (`wall_switches` through `face_threat`). The search is the only caller, and the greedy baseline never calls them, so both follow `AI_EVAL`'s flag. Do not change any public signature.

6. **`crates/ai/README.md`.** After "(`gauntlet_bars_face_attacks`, R1849005, #3287; off in `GREEDY_EVAL`)." add: "A unit whose own Brittle tick destroys it at the start of its controller's next turn, before it can attack, threatens no face and stands nothing down: `face_threat` and `could_attack_next_turn` ask `crumbles_before_swinging` (`brittle_crumbles_before_swing`, R3793000, #3793; off in `GREEDY_EVAL`)."

     - R385 ticks a count at the start of its controller's turn from t + 2. At 0 the card is destroyed, which Indestructible ignores (R46). A unit at Brittle 1 whose first tick is due by its controller's next turn is destroyed at that turn's start, so it never attacks again. A grown Corpse Eater (#89, Rush, Brittle 1) at 8 attack still made `face_threat` read lethal.

The next start is the next turn when it is the other player's now or the controller owes an extra turn (R846), else the one after.
     - It applies to both seats' units, so the AI's own crumbling unit adds no pressure. It reaches the threat and pressure terms, `wall_switches`, `stands_down` and the learned features through `face_threat`.

Summarize step 7's body, and add the rejected alternatives: the Brittle test inside `can_swing`, which `unit_worth` reads, and a weights parameter on `stands_down` and `wall_switches`.

9. **`spec/09-architecture.md`.** In §9.9's Evaluation bullet, replace `and the enemy's face-down cards. A Dormant card on the board` with `and the enemy's face-down cards. That face damage leaves out a Unit whose own Brittle tick destroys it at the start of its controller's next turn, before it can attack ([[R3793000]]). A Dormant card on the board`. The anchor occurs exactly once.

## Tests

**Engine.** In `crates/engine/tests/rules/brittle.rs`, inside `mod r385_b3_3_where_a_brittle_count_lives_and_when_it_starts`, after `r385_the_other_players_start_of_turn_never_ticks_a_count`:

**AI.** `crates/ai/tests/ai/brittle.rs` opens with a header comment citing R3793000 and #3793, then:
- `use jackioh_ai::*; use jackioh_engine::testkit::*; use super::support::{AI, HUMAN, close, in_graveyard, on_field, register_cards, unit};`
- Constants: `VANILLA = "core-008"` (4/4), `TIMMY = "core-011"` (3/3), `BIG = "core-025"` (7/7, Taunt in Defense, as in `gauntlet.rs`), `ROCK = "core-066"` (10/10 Indestructible), `EATER = "core-089"` (Corpse Eater), `LIBRARY: &[&str] = &["core-008","core-011","core-008","core-011"]`.
- `const OFF: EvalWeights = EvalWeights { brittle_crumbles_before_swing: false, ..AI_EVAL };`

- `fn lethal_board() -> GameState`: AI at 7 life with `BIG` in lane 3, against the human's `VANILLA` in lanes 2, 3 and 4. Same shape as `gauntlet.rs`'s `board`.

All tests are `#[test]`:

1. `r3793000_a_unit_whose_brittle_tick_falls_before_its_next_swing_adds_nothing_to_the_face_threat`

- [ ] The same unit with its first tick not yet due counts, a Brittle-2 unit counts, and an Indestructible one counts (tests 3 and 4).

## Risks

- **Learned eval.** `features.rs` feeds `face_threat` (`AI_EVAL`) into the learned network, so Brittle boards shift its input. If `learned.rs` parity or any pinned test fails, find out why. Do not edit fixtures to pass.
- **Existing Brittle tests.** `evaluate_v020.rs`'s B3.3 test still holds: a Brittle-1 own unit now scores lower, never higher. Its greedy assert is untouched.
- **Tick-turn error.** Extra turns are the issue's named risk. The helper reads the engine's own `since` and `BRITTLE_FIRST_TICK_TURNS` through `brittle_due_by`, and tests 8 and 9 tie it to the real `reduce` and tick.
- **Hot path.** `face_threat_with` runs twice per evaluation. The new check short-circuits on `active_brittle_count` being `None` and on the flag, and allocates nothing.
- **Purity and hidden information.** Only public state is read (the count on a field unit, turn, active seat, `extra_turns`), and no new constant or I/O is added (rules 4, 7 and 9).
- **Rejected alternatives.**
  - Putting the check in `can_swing` was rejected because `unit_worth` reads it, and the issue leaves worth alone.
  - A weights parameter on `stands_down` and `wall_switches` was rejected because it changes public signatures, and the search always uses `AI_EVAL`.
  - Modeling the other player's extra turns was rejected as it only delays the tick.
  - Reborn Brittle units that return after the crumble are left unmodeled.

None.
